findings.title: XSS via img onerror - CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' parameter unsanitized into the HTML body. The application blocks
findings.evidence: GET /page?name= Response: Congratulations! Here is the flag: flag{3ae95ac5-69f0-4a02-82be-8d3afbd697c8}

diagrams.title: Dalgona XSS Challenge Architecture
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  Browser["Browser (Attacker)"] --> Home["GET / - Dalgona Challenges Index"]
  Home --> Page["GET /page - XSS Challenge (xss7)"]
  Page --> NameParam["?name= parameter (reflected unsanitized)"]
  NameParam --> Filter["Server-side filter - blocks script tags"]
  Filter -->|"Blocked"| ErrorResp["Response: Failed / no reflection"]
  Filter -->|"Bypassed - img onerror"| FlagResp["Response: Congratulations + flag{...}"]
  Page --> Static["GET /static/* - CSS and images"]
  FlagResp --> Flag["flag{3ae95ac5-69f0-4a02-82be-8d3afbd697c8}"]
